cap: Three breast cancer presentations are recognized by what the cells do. DCIS fills ducts in solid, cribriform, papillary or comedo patterns, and calcified comedo necrosis shows on a mammogram. Inflammatory carcinoma plugs dermal lymphatics with tumor emboli, so the skin is red, warm and dimpled. Paget disease is carcinoma cells in the nipple epidermis, spread from underlying DCIS or invasive cancer.
